## [1.1.0](https://github.com/Ayufa/youtube-custom-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-11-04)

### ✨ New Features

* Restore the Live latency keeper with a Morphe settings toggle ([812189e](https://github.com/Ayufa/youtube-custom-patches/commit/812189eb8b6d38b0a6e0fb51386ea63340aee267))
* Support the Live latency keeper on YouTube 21.30.216 as well ([9b1f35b](https://github.com/Ayufa/youtube-custom-patches/commit/9b1f35b04aa0f69a69e28398d43206d1b98e0c10))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Add temporary diagnostic logging to find why the keeper does not seek ([69edf67](https://github.com/Ayufa/youtube-custom-patches/commit/69edf677a4b07ef1b2479b8ea2daf5dc01b3b379))
* Estimate live lag from wall-clock time instead of the video length ([bfbca52](https://github.com/Ayufa/youtube-custom-patches/commit/bfbca522833b417f166a0db98ec162870165e6f6))

patches.name: Hide live chat clutter
patches.description: Hides the pinned message banner and poll cards in live chat. Each can be toggled in Morphe settings (Ayufa patch settings) without re-patching. For YouTube 21.30.216.

options.description: Hides the pinned comment (banner) shown above the live chat.
Hides poll (questionnaire) cards shown in the live chat.

patches.name: Live latency keeper
patches.description: Periodically checks live stream playback and automatically seeks to the live edge when playback has fallen behind. Can be toggled in Morphe settings (Ayufa patch settings) without re-patching. For YouTube 20.26.46 (Android 8.0) and 21.30.216. Requires the official Morphe patches to be applied as well.

options.description: How often to check how far live playback is behind the live edge.
Seek to the live edge when playback is behind it by more than this.
Seek to this many seconds before the live edge, to avoid rebuffering at the very edge.
